name: hukuhaka-worklog
description: Maintain project working memory, retain outcomes and checkpoints, and automatically archive older history.

interface.shortDescription: Keep current work and decision history consistent.
interface.longDescription: Keep English progress notes, nested steps, decisions, and checkpoints across sessions. Trusted hooks archive older history after changelog edits; setup, status, and manual archive remain available as commands.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $hukuhaka-worklog:worklog to record or update this project's work.
